lines: As always, she had little hesitation.
Yukikaze began charging her twin pistols with lightning energy as if to say, "I'm done with this."
*Bzrt bzrt bzrt bzrt bzrt bzrt bzrt!!*
Tremendous electric sparks flew around Yukikaze, flashing and glowing dazzlingly.
Forget just blowing away the trouble makers, she was building enough energy to wipe out the entire casino.
For real!? Wait, wait! Waiiit! It was a joke! Just a joke!!!
Put all your guns down, too! We'll be in big trouble if she fires that! Stop, stop!!
The blonde man had suddenly changed his attitude and relaxed his guard, but Yukikaze wasn't one to listen.
She appeared to have listened to me at least, and the bundle of electric energy that threatened the entire casino suddenly vanished.
Ohhhh, that was scaaary!! You brought a hell of a woman with you, young lord!
The explosive situation was completely defused, and the blonde man, known as Kanzaki Jyubei, had extended his hand to me.
Yukikaze looked over at us shaking hands with a suspicious look.
I told you we came to meet an old friend of mine, didn't I? You're too hotheaded.
It's only natural to want to beat people up after they say things like that!
I'm sorry about them. I'm Kanzaki Jyubei. Nice to meet you.
Yukikaze let out a huff, but Jyubei paid it no mind and simply grinned.
Jyubei is from the Fuma Clan and was in service to the Nisha family.
Nisha? You mean the one that Gaiza's from?
Jyubei's distantly related to him. And Gaiza and I are his childhood friends.
Well, he's gone independent now and is running the gang that owns the Senzaki casino.
Kanzaki Jyubei, the gangster shining bright as a star in the Senzaki darkness!
Jyubei flashed his sparkling white teeth and struck a pose looking off into the distance.
I get it. He's stupid, right?
Hahahaha! You're as harsh as always!!
Jyubei laughed loudly and slapped my back again and again.
You haven't changed a bit either.
I've been hearing about you, young lord!
What are you talking about!? You're a captain leading his own unit now, right? And...
Hehehe! You've got a scary but hot woman with you, that's the proof you made it in life!
Ogled by Jyubei from head to toe, Yukikaze grimaced.
Hey, you. Did he bang you already?
Haagh!? Wh-Why would I let him...!?
Yukikaze was about to fly into another rage as she reached for her guns again but Jyubei made a grandiose show of calming her.
Oh, whoa, please, not those again. What, so not yet huh!?
No, not yet, or ever, there's no way we'd do it!!
Several lights in the casino shattered as Yukikaze yelled.
Jyubei made a face as if to say, "Whoa, scary," then spoke to me.
Well, that's because the young lord is so～ serious. But you definitely banged Hebiko already, right?
It had been a while since I had met him, but he kept joking around. I couldn't hide my wry smile.
I'll take anything but that octopus ink!! Well, we have a lot to catch up on. Let's talk over drink. Lightning girl, you'll join us, right?
Jyubei put his arm around my shoulders and tried to take me to a private room.
In an instant, nostalgic memories came flooding back, and I wanted nothing more than to accept him in that moment.
I'll have to decline, Jyubei. I came because I wanted to ask you something.
As if he'd expected that answer, Jyubei easily relinquished his hold on me.
It's always the same with you and Gaiza, young lord. You two aren't very sociable. You only think about getting your business finished.
Sorry about that. Have you met with Gaiza recently?
With his messenger, yes. He wouldn't shut up about asking me to become his subordinate. I told him that if he wanted me to join so bad, he should get his stupid ass here and ask me himself.
That side of him has always made Gaiza incapable of leading others. At least you had the decency to come see me yourself, young lord.
Is Gaiza gathering Taimanin from the Fuma Clan?
I heard that Tekkain sis received an invitation as well.
I wasn't certain whether it was a reflection of his honest feelings or not, but Jyubei said it as if to say he couldn't care less even in the slightest.
I replied to Yukikaze who had whispered her question to me.
Tekkain Kaoru. Like Jyubei, she was from the Fuma Clan and had served the Nisha family before. She was also the head of the Tekkain Family.
And just as I did, she said goodbye to the Fuma and is now ruling a part of the City of Darkness.
His tone had a hint of mockery for the Fuma Clan which had fallen apart.
Perhaps sensing those complex feelings, Yukikaze was keeping her mouth shut.
She the one you wanted to ask about?
No, it's about Kurenai. Do you know where she is?
My words made Jyubei speechless for a brief period.
...You mean Shinganji Kurenai!? Are you trying to make Kurenai your ally!?
Sorry, but it's not like that. There's something I want to ask her. Whether she assassinated a certain person or not.
Assassinated!? Sounds like trouble if you ask me.
I won't cause you any trouble.
I briefly explained to him how my Taimanin friend (Shinohara Mari) had met Kurenai in this city and helped her defeat the Book Djinn.
I've heard about this. They put down a legendary Book Djinn, right?
Then that makes this easier. Do you know where Kurenai might be if she's still in Senzaki?
The moment I asked, I had the impression that the air enveloping Jyubei suddenly darkened.
Hey, young lord. Whoever they may be, once they set their foot in this city, they're an inhabitant of Senzaki.
Did you think I, the Gang-star of Senzaki, would give information about one of us to a Gosha dog?
I did. That's why I came here.
Do I? The Jyubei I know would know the value of information and would also know when and who to give it to.
I stared into Jyubei's eyes and then turned on my heels.
But it looks like I wrong about you. Let's go, Yukikaze.
It's a waste of time staying here any longer. We have many ways to look for what we need. We are Taimanin after all.
Y-Yeah. If you're okay with it then fine but...
With the confused Yukikaze following behind I was about to leave, but...
Alright already!! Damn, you're hopeless. This is exactly why it's hard to deal with you, young lord.
Oh, so you feel like talking now? I didn't expect anything less from you, Jyubei. You are the shining "gang-star," after all.
Shut up. Seriously, what a sweet-talker.
Jyubei shook his head in resignation before he spoke again.
Well, to get straight to the point, I do know. Kurenai is, in fact, here in this city.
